pages.text: The next day, Julia has to go to class. "Stay in the play house," she said. "I will be back after lunch."
pages.picture: the girl with a school backpack waving goodbye to the dragon in the playhouse
the dragon alone in the playhouse, chin on his paws, bored

pages.text: After class, Julia runs to the backyard. "Toby! I am back!"
pages.picture: the girl running into the backyard with her backpack, happy

pages.text: But then she stops. Her scooter is on its side, and the wheel is bent!
pages.picture: a scooter lying on its side with a bent wheel
the girl with hands on hips

pages.text: Toby looks down at his feet. He is so, so sad. A big tear drips off his nose.
pages.picture: the dragon looking down, very sad, a tear on his nose

pages.text: Julia huffs. "That was my best scooter!" She stomps off into the house.
But Julia can not stay cross for long.
pages.picture: the girl standing in the open back door of her family's big house, looking back across the garden at the small pink playhouse in the distance, her cross face softening

pages.text: Soon she is back with her kite. "Come on, Toby," she said. "Let's play."
pages.picture: the girl holding a kite, smiling at the dragon peeking out of the playhouse
